inspiration: Placed props drawn as instanced meshes with a world matrix per placement (DaocClientLib.Drawing/DungeonRenderer.cs:55).
Hand-tuned overrides on procedural placement: per-tree offsets in a replacement map (DaocClientLib/Tree/TreeReplacementMap.cs:35).
Rivers and lava as one typed band record with banks and a type field (DaocClientLib/Zone/RiverGeometry.cs:34-52).
Terrain height kept apart from zone renderers (DaocClientLib/Zone/TerrainHeightCalculator.cs; Drawing/TerrainRenderer.cs).
Crafting recipe as a record with an ingredient collection (DaocClientLib/Craft/CraftDataRecipe.cs:33-72).
Zone jump points as their own data records (DaocClientLib/Zone/ZoneJump.cs, JumpPoint.cs).
A demo UI built from one skin PNG (DaocClientLib.Demo/GwenSkin.png).

briefs.label: Lava river band (own label)
briefs.why: a glowing lava channel with stone banks reads as danger at a distance and follows a path
briefs.keep: banked band defined as data with a liquid type field; one shape for water and lava
briefs.change: our own cracked bank stones; ember glow and heat shimmer instead of water texture; different width profile

briefs.label: Hand-tuned tree offsets (own label)
briefs.why: a procedural forest keeps a few trees where a designer needs them
briefs.keep: override list keyed by tree, offset applied on match
briefs.change: per-cell offsets rather than per-tree; a tree-type swap as well as offset

briefs.label: Instanced dungeon props (own label)
briefs.why: many repeated props (pillars, braziers) draw cheaply with per-placement transforms
briefs.change: our own prop designs; per-prop tint variation

briefs.label: Craft recipe card (own label)
briefs.why: a recipe with a visible ingredient list reads at a glance
briefs.keep: recipe record with an ingredient collection
briefs.change: our own ingredient icons and result preview; grouping by station
